config.valid_variable_day: >=1 stored issuance; single-issuance days counted as unrevised in Part 1 denominators (H0002 convention, mirrored)
config.revision_definition: first-issued value != final-issued value, Decimal-quantized to 0.01 (construction/rounding frozen -- see decimal_policy); any-revision indicator per variable-day; first = min(issuance_time), final = max(issuance_time)
config.attribution_rule: revised tmin day is post-midnight-attributed iff the earliest issuance whose quantized value equals the final value has local(issuance_time) >= 00:00:00 America/Chicago on observation_date + 1 day; issuance_time interpreted as naive-UTC; unresolved cases remain in denominator as non-attributed -- PREREG Sec 4
config.decimal_policy: float->Decimal construction via Decimal(str(v)) only, never Decimal(v); value quantization to 0.01 via ROUND_HALF_EVEN; round-trip invariant (|float(quantized) - raw_float| < 1e-6) checked under gate G2, violation aborts -- H0011 AMENDMENT Finding 3, inherited
config.station_filter: frozen filter step: station_id == 'CHI' applied after G1 (full-frame hash) and before G2 -- PREREG Sec 2/8
config.estimand_1: D_chi = p_tmin - p_tmax (proportion of revised CHI variable-days); positive = tmin revises more
config.estimand_2: p_pm_chi = X_pm / R_tmin (proportion of revised CHI tmin variable-days post-midnight-attributed)
config.ci_method_estimand_1: Newcombe (1998) hybrid score interval for a difference of independent proportions, no continuity correction, two-sided 95% -- PREREG Sec 6
config.ci_method_estimand_2: Wilson score interval, no continuity correction, two-sided 95% -- PREREG Sec 6
config.exact_arithmetic: integer counts; Decimal precision-50 interval bounds; all strict decision comparisons after 1e-12 ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantization of both operands; quantized equality never satisfies a strict inequality -- PREREG Sec 6
config.pairing_treatment: decisional interval unpaired (H0011 audit-approved convention, inherited); no paired robustness check exists -- H0011 AMENDMENT Finding 2
config.decision_rule: 1) any gate fails -> EXECUTION BLOCKED; 2) L(D_chi) <= 0 -> Rejected; 3) L(D_chi) > 0 and L(p_pm_chi) > 1/2 -> Confirmed; 4) L(D_chi) > 0 and U(p_pm_chi) < 1/2 -> Rejected (formation-timing conjunct refuted); 5) L(D_chi) > 0 and interval straddles 1/2 -> Inconclusive -- PREREG Sec 7.1
config.random_seed: not applicable -- fully deterministic, no resampling
config.part_2_scope_statement: This result is evidence about settlement-label formation timing only -- that revised daily-minimum labels typically reach their final value in a post-midnight issuance. It does not identify the timing of the underlying physical temperature event (when the true daily minimum occurred), because this dataset carries issuance timestamps only, not occurrence timestamps. A study identifying the physical mechanism would require new occurrence-time data (e.g. parsed from raw CLI product text) and would constitute a separate, future hypothesis, not a re-interpretation of this one.

nyc_consistency_check.note: expected +1 day per variable vs published (archive advanced 2026-07-20 -> 2026-07-21 between pins); larger divergence is a data-integrity flag -- PREREG Sec 9

reproducibility_verification.serialization_policy: Every non-integer decision-relevant quantity in primary_results is a JSON string: the Decimal value quantized to 1e-12 via ROUND_HALF_EVEN, fixed-point notation, exactly 12 digits after the decimal point, no scientific notation, leading '-' only if negative -- H0011 AMENDMENT Finding 4, inherited. Integer counts remain plain JSON integers.
